name: discord-draft
description: A band above the prompt and a pane where Claude drafts a Discord message and you press Send to post it to your channel's webhook, plus a read-only tool that reads the channel through a bot

webhook_url.title: Discord webhook URL
webhook_url.description: Channel → Edit Channel → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy Webhook URL. Kept in ~/.claude/settings.json on this computer (not the repo).

channel_label.title: Channel name shown in the pane
channel_label.description: Shown in the pane title, for example #talk

sender_name.title: Name the message is posted under
sender_name.description: The name Discord shows on messages posted through the webhook, for example "yourname (via Claude)"

bot_token.title: Discord bot token (read-only bot)
bot_token.description: Paste it in the /discord pane, not here. Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token. A secret: reset it if it leaks.

channel_id.title: Channel id to read
channel_id.description: The channel read_discord reads (Developer Mode → right-click the channel → Copy Channel ID)
